name: sealos
description: Sealos deployment-YAML preparation, database, object storage, and app-building skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare app YAML and connect Sealos cloud services
interface.longDescription: Use Sealos in Codex to assess cloud-native readiness, generate production Dockerfiles, build or reuse container images, and convert project topology into validated Sealos deployment YAML. The sealos-deploy skill stops after Phase 4 and does not deploy or update workloads. The plugin can also connect cloud databases, configure S3-compatible object storage, and build Sealos Desktop apps with SDK integration guidance. The plugin bundles Sealos Agent Skills under ./skills/ and is invoked as $sealos in Codex or /sealos in Claude Code-compatible hosts.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Sealos deployment YAML for this repo.
Containerize this app and prepare its Sealos YAML.
Create private S3 object storage and wire env vars.
